{{Quote|Pilot! I've got Black Sun on my-- Pilot! Are you out there? We're coming in now. Get these vessels off me!|Atris, to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:BSA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Black Sun Attacks|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
'''Atris''' was an individual who served as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] and [[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]] of the [[Dynath Miners]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], Atris's starship, the [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]] ''[[Draosa Star]]'', was attacked by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in the [[Bright Jewel Ribbon]]. The pilot managed to successfully destroy multiple enemy ships before being overwhelmed. Atris was eventually rescued by [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] starfighters dispatched by [[Aleas Rans'ery]].<ref name="SWG:BSA" />
